securityNotices.mcpForeignOrigin.title: Cmdr blocked a web page from reaching the MCP server
securityNotices.mcpForeignOrigin.body: A web page open in your browser tried to talk to Cmdr. Nothing got in. If it keeps happening, close tabs you don’t trust.
securityNotices.smbSignatureRefused.titl: Cmdr refused a reply from a server
securityNotices.smbSignatureRefused.body: The reply didn’t carry the server’s signature, so Cmdr didn’t trust it. A flaky network device can cause this, and so can someone tampering with traffic between you and the server. Reconnect, and if it happens again, check your network.
securityNotices.updateNotGenuine.title: Cmdr didn’t install this update: it isn’t a genuine Cmdr release
securityNotices.updateNotGenuine.body: Every update has to carry Cmdr’s signature, and this one doesn’t. Nothing was installed, and your current Cmdr is untouched. Get the latest version from getcmdr.com, and please tell David: it may mean someone is tampering with updates.
